newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chase to launch LAF-eligible HK$ FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Chase to launch LAF-eligible HK$ FRCD.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank, Hong Kong branch, plans to issue a three-year HK$1.5 billion floating rate certificate of deposit later this week, Chase said on Monday.
Application will be made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the certificates as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Eligibility for LAF makes an issue more attractive to banks because holders of the qualifying debt can engage in repurchase agreements with the monetary authority, increasing liquidity.
